title: Meeting at the station
instructions: Anna ve Tim istasyonda buluşmaya çalışıyor. Kısa bir diyalog; nerede olduklarına dikkat et.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: Tim, where are you? I'm at the station.

script.speaker: tim
script.text: I'm at the station too! I'm next to the ticket office.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: I'm at the café near platform two.

script.speaker: tim
script.text: OK, stay there. I'm coming in two minutes.

questions.feedback: Tim bilet gişesinin yanında (next to the ticket office).
questions.evidence: I'm next to the ticket office.

options: at the café near platform two
questions.feedback: Anna iki numaralı peronun yanındaki kafede.
questions.evidence: I'm at the café near platform two.

questions.prompt: Who is going to walk to the other person?
questions.feedback: Tim "stay there, I'm coming" diyor; o yürüyecek.
questions.evidence: OK, stay there. I'm coming in two minutes.

questions.prompt: When is Tim going to arrive?
questions.feedback: İki dakika içinde (in two minutes) gelecek.
